interface.title: LensAudit · Mass is inferred, not photographed (Dark Matter Lensing Auditor)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and validation: comparing a lensing convergence (κ) model with an optical light map, checking the method against synthetic data with known truth, and exporting audit artifacts
interface.what_it_is_for: Overlay a lensing convergence map on an optical image, measure how far mass and light are offset and where their shapes disagree across an ensemble of lens models, and export a JSON evidence receipt and a FITS discrepancy map, with real-data, user-upload and synthetic-validation routes kept separate.

data.note: All results came from the built-in synthetic generator in '03 · Validation lab' (a fixed 24-model ensemble). Runs, in order: seed 7 at smoothing 2 / threshold 3 (twice, once per export); seed 7 at smoothing 5 / threshold 3; seed 7 at smoothing 5 / threshold 5; seed 42 at smoothing 0 / threshold 2; seed 43 at smoothing 0 / threshold 2. The '01 · Official HFF' route needs products prepared beforehand by a CLI step that was never run, so it shows 'Prepared products were not found'. '02 · Your FITS' needs the user's own FITS pair, and no test files were available. Two files were downloaded: downloads/lensing-audit.json (twice: smoothing 2 / threshold 3, then smoothing 0 / threshold 2) and downloads/discrepancy-score.fits (299,520 bytes, binary).

features.specific: 'Dark Matter Lensing Auditor — evidence map' panels: Luminous-matter proxy; Lensing mass contours on light with light/mass centroid markers; Mass–light morphology residual (normalized mass − fitted light); Ensemble-aware discrepancy score with a black contour always at score 3, whatever the sidebar threshold (plotting.py:33 per review; same outline in screens/019.webp and screens/021.webp)

features.name: Interpretation guardrails panel
features.general: Next to the numbers, show automatic warnings, a statement of what the result does not prove, and a checklist of what would disprove it
features.specific: Validity boundary box, 'Machine warnings' alert ('Discrepancy score is a model-audit diagnostic, not a formal dark-matter detection significance'), and 'What could falsify this map' list (different modeling team, PSF matching, constraint region, reprojection, stellar-mass proxy). Extra warnings for a single κ model, fewer than 5 models, or more than 25% of the map above threshold come from core.py:169-173 (per review) and were not triggered by the 24-model synthetic data
